name: Cube-Intersection Operator
definition: For a median graph $G$, $Q_k(G)$ has the maximal induced cubes of $G$ as vertices and joins two when their intersection has dimension at least $k$; $Q_0(G)=Q(G)$ records nonempty intersection. The variant $Q_{m2}(G)$ joins pairs whose nonempty intersection is inclusion-maximal among pairwise maximal-cube intersections.
comments: An iterate is considered only while every intermediate graph remains median. The fixed-$k$ and maximal-2 operators have different product behavior.
